title: Chirpy and the Stormy Day
moral: Scary moments do not last forever and can lead to something beautiful.

scenes.summary: Chirpy the sparrow loves flying but is afraid of storms.
scenes.text:
Chirpy the Sparrow and the Stormy Day

In a big green tree near a quiet village, lived a tiny sparrow named Chirpy.

Chirpy loved flying high in the sky.

She loved the warm sun, the soft breeze, and singing cheerful songs.

But there was one thing Chirpy did not like…

Storms.
scenes.image_prompt: cute sparrow flying happily in sunny sky near green tree and village, colorful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Chirpy fears storms despite reassurance from her friend Bittu.
scenes.text:
Whenever dark clouds gathered, Chirpy would rush back to her nest.

“The wind is too strong!” she chirped.

“The thunder is too loud!”

Her friend Bittu the Bulbul would say,

“Storms come and go, Chirpy. Don’t worry.”

But Chirpy still felt scared.
scenes.image_prompt: small sparrow looking scared at dark clouds while another bird comforts her, cartoon style

scenes.summary: Chirpy gets caught in a storm far from home and feels lost and frightened.
scenes.text:
One afternoon, while Chirpy was flying far from home, the sky suddenly grew dark.

Boom!

Thunder roared.

Whooooosh!

The wind blew hard.

“Oh no!” Chirpy cried.

“I’m too far from my nest!”

The wind pushed Chirpy off her path.

She fluttered and struggled.

“I can’t see my tree!” she said.

Rain began to pour.

Drip! Drop! Splash!

Chirpy felt tiny and scared.
scenes.image_prompt: small bird struggling in strong wind and rain storm, dark sky, dramatic but child-friendly cartoon

scenes.summary: Kavi the Tortoise helps Chirpy stay safe and teaches her storms will pass.
scenes.text:
Just then, she heard a voice below.

“Come here, little one!”

It was Kavi the Tortoise, sitting under a large leaf.

“Stay under this leaf,” Kavi said.

“You’ll be safe.”

Chirpy quickly flew down and hid beside him.

They waited quietly as the storm passed.

Kavi spoke softly,

“Storms may seem scary, but they don’t last forever.”

Chirpy listened.

Slowly, the rain stopped.

The wind grew gentle.

And the sky began to clear.
scenes.image_prompt: tortoise sheltering small bird under big leaf during rain, calm comforting cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Chirpy sees a rainbow, learns storms pass, and is no longer afraid.
scenes.text:
Soon, the sun peeked out from behind the clouds.

A rainbow stretched across the sky.

“Wow…” Chirpy whispered.

“That’s beautiful.”

She smiled.

“Maybe storms aren’t so bad after all.”

Kavi nodded.

“They bring rain… and sometimes, rainbows.”

Chirpy found her way back home safely.

From that day on, she wasn’t as afraid of storms.

She knew they would pass—and something beautiful might follow.

Scary moments don’t last forever.

Sometimes, they lead to something beautiful.

The End

story:
Chirpy the Sparrow and the Stormy Day

In a big green tree near a quiet village, lived a tiny sparrow named Chirpy.

Chirpy loved flying high in the sky.

She loved the warm sun, the soft breeze, and singing cheerful songs.

But there was one thing Chirpy did not like…

Storms.

Whenever dark clouds gathered, Chirpy would rush back to her nest.

“The wind is too strong!” she chirped.

“The thunder is too loud!”

Her friend Bittu the Bulbul would say,

“Storms come and go, Chirpy. Don’t worry.”

But Chirpy still felt scared.

One afternoon, while Chirpy was flying far from home, the sky suddenly grew dark.

Boom!

Thunder roared.

Whooooosh!

The wind blew hard.

“Oh no!” Chirpy cried.

“I’m too far from my nest!”

The wind pushed Chirpy off her path.

She fluttered and struggled.

“I can’t see my tree!” she said.

Rain began to pour.

Drip! Drop! Splash!

Chirpy felt tiny and scared.

Just then, she heard a voice below.

“Come here, little one!”

It was Kavi the Tortoise, sitting under a large leaf.

“Stay under this leaf,” Kavi said.

“You’ll be safe.”

Chirpy quickly flew down and hid beside him.

They waited quietly as the storm passed.

Kavi spoke softly,

“Storms may seem scary, but they don’t last forever.”

Chirpy listened.

Slowly, the rain stopped.

The wind grew gentle.

And the sky began to clear.

Soon, the sun peeked out from behind the clouds.

A rainbow stretched across the sky.

“Wow…” Chirpy whispered.

“That’s beautiful.”

She smiled.

“Maybe storms aren’t so bad after all.”

Kavi nodded.

“They bring rain… and sometimes, rainbows.”

Chirpy found her way back home safely.

From that day on, she wasn’t as afraid of storms.

She knew they would pass—and something beautiful might follow.

Scary moments don’t last forever.

Sometimes, they lead to something beautiful.

The End
